title: Attio closing CTA
description: The closing call to action on a dark pinstriped band inside the page frame: a big centred two-line white heading and two buttons (an outline 'talk to us' and a graphite 'start'); on phones an email field, a full-width button and a text link with an arrow.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
